Clean Opta summary goal events: drop phantom copies, credit own goals

Source: R/utils.R
dot-clean_goal_events.Rd

Two defects in opta_events.parquet's event_type == "goal" rows, both found in the 2026-10-11 codebase review:

  1. Phantom copies. Older feeds (in the RAPM leagues: about all matches 2014-2017, about 30\ twice: once timed, once at minute 0 second 0 (the scraper's fallback when a goal record has no time). Counted by team, a 2-1 becomes 4-2, and in the splint timeline the copies all land at kick-off. A row at 0:00 is dropped when the same player has a timed goal in that match, one copy per timed goal. A genuine untimed goal by a player who also scored a timed one is indistinguishable and is dropped too (about 2 of 238k matches in the 2026-10 corpus).

  2. Wrong team, including own goals (R022). An own goal row carries the CONCEDING team, so Fulham 1-1 Man Utd (Martinez OG) counted 0-2, and some older rows carry the wrong team outright. Each goal is matched to its goal shot (same match and player, nearest minute within 2; old seasons store minute+1 and second 0) and takes the shooter's team, or the opponent when the shot has Opta's own-goal qualifier 28.

Usage

.clean_goal_events(events, goal_shots, match_teams)

Arguments

events

Summary events with match_id, event_type, team_id, player_id, minute, second.

goal_shots

Goal shot events (type 16) with match_id, player_id, team_id (the shooter's team), minute and is_own_goal.

match_teams

One row per match: match_id, home_team_id, away_team_id.

Value

events without the phantom rows, with team_id switched to the opponent on own goals and a logical is_own_goal column, plus attribute goal_cleaning = c(phantoms_dropped, own_goals_flipped, own_goals_unmatched, wrong_team_fixed).
